entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It is contended by the counsel that the applicant is "Dewarani" of the victim-Pallavi Mishra, has been falsely implicated in this case.
The police after holding the superficial and cursory investigation has submitted report under Section 173(2) Cr.P.C. under the aforesaid sections of the IPC.

Learned counsel for the applicant have hammered his submissions, only on the issue of pasting Section 313 IPC along with other sections of IPC and contended that no case of Section 313 IPC is made out against the applicant.

I have carefully gone through the medical report and there is specific finding regarding bleeding from her vagina and the statement of the doctors, which clearly indicates that there was termination of her pregnancy.
Without adverting anything on the merit of the case, it is open for the applicant to raise all his objection at the time of framing of charge.

Learned trial judge after hearing the contesting parties with regard to the application under Section 313 IPC shall pass a well reasoned order as to the additional of Section 313 IPC among other sections of the IPC.
With observation the present 482 Cr.P.C. application stands dispose of.
